title: HarvestGuard validation manifest (HG-045)
description: The frozen corpus and expectation record written at stage 6, before HarvestGuard runs. Never rewritten by a scan result. Deliberately holds no passphrase, private key content, plaintext, decrypted material, or raw secret value; the only secret-adjacent field is `secret_marker`, a per-run prefix shared by the disposable passphrases the harness generated, which exists so stage 8 can prove nothing leaked.

run_id.description: Randomized per-run identity. Workspace paths and artifact names vary with it.

scan_root.description: Absolute path of the frozen corpus. Nothing outside it is scanned.

scan_commands.description: Exact HarvestGuard commands stage 7 will run, recorded before it runs them.

unmanifested_corpus_files.description: Files found inside the frozen corpus that no manifest entry covers. Reported as accounting mismatches at stage 8.

source_category.description: Generated artifacts, operator-supplied artifacts with a declared expectation, and blind operator inputs stay distinguishable through to the final report.

relative_path.description: Path relative to the validation corpus root.

command_description.description: Safe description of the generating command, with secret arguments redacted.

expected_rule_id.description: Empty when HarvestGuard publishes no rule ID for the family; matching then falls back to expected_asset_type.

forbidden_rule_ids.description: Rule IDs that must NOT fire for a negative control.

additional_expected.description: Further rule IDs or asset types acknowledged in advance at this location, so they are not reported as unexpected.

expected_scanner_error.description: Declared before the scan: a parse attempt against this artifact may legitimately record a scanner error.
